    🔌 SPX BRIDGE Required

    Automatic SPX Sync needs the SPX BRIDGE extension.

    Install SPX BRIDGE
    1. Create a new empty folder anywhere on your PC.
    2. Click ⚡ Install SPX BRIDGE Files below.
    3. When Chrome asks for a folder, select the folder you just created.
    4. Press to copy it. Then press ctrl+t , ctrl+v, then press enter.
    5. Turn Developer mode ON. In the top - right corner of your screen.
    6. Click Load unpacked in the top - left corner of your screen and select the folder that you created.
    7. Return to BADOC and refresh the page.

    The folder name can be anything. Chrome only needs manifest.json directly inside the folder you select with Load unpacked.

    🔌 SPX BRIDGE Required — Dispatch

    Dispatch needs SPX BRIDGE v69.3.7 to sync parcels. The rest of BADOC HUB remains separate.

    Install SPX BRIDGE v69.3.7
    1. Click Download SPX BRIDGE File below and choose an empty folder (or your existing v69 extension folder).
    2. Open .
    3. Enable Developer mode, click Load unpacked, and select the folder that contains manifest.json.
    4. Return to BADOC HUB and open Dispatch again. Sync buttons will check the connection before starting.
    Browser limitation: Chrome requires the one-time user action to load an unpacked extension. This popup can prepare the v69 files but cannot silently register the extension.
